lines: This is the idea behind ditto spending.
So “ditto spending” means buying the same things as others whose taste or style is similar to yours.
Because of social media, ditto spending is growing fast.
For example, many people follow a star or influencer whose style they like.
They often buy the same things—such as clothes, food, or other items—as this person.
They think, “If it’s good for them, it must be good for me, too.”
This kind of spending can feel easy and safe, but it can cause problems.
People may buy things they don’t really need and waste money.
They might lose their own style and feel unhappy with what they bought.
In the end, they may miss the chance to make their own decisions.
